# Temple Scroll Column 24 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 24 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**24:1** Build a slaughtering area on the north side of the altar with twenty-four iron rings set into the ground.

**24:2** Anchor the rings to pillars standing on copper bases. These rings are for tethering the bulls, rams, and goats during slaughter.

**24:3** Tie the lambs and young goats to the rings as well, and slaughter them before Me on the altar's north side.

**24:4** In the slaughtering area, mount copper hooks on the upper portions of the pillars for hanging the animals and stripping their hides.

**24:5** Place stone preparation tables next to the pillars for laying out the butchered portions — each table two cubits long, one and a half cubits wide, and one cubit tall.

**24:6** Keep the slaughtering tools on these tables: the knives and the collecting bowls used for burnt offerings and sacrifices.

**24:7** Dig drainage channels in the ground beside the altar to carry away the blood. The blood will flow through these channels into an underground drain.

**24:8** No layperson may enter the slaughtering area. Only the priests descended from Aaron may perform the slaughter before Me.

**24:9** The priests shall throw the blood against every side of the altar, then burn the fat on the altar.

**24:10** They shall remove the fat that encases the organs, the fat clinging to the intestines, both kidneys with the fat around them near the lower back, and the fatty lobe attached to the liver — removing it all along with the kidneys.

**24:11** The priest shall burn these on the altar as a fire-offering, producing an aroma that pleases Me, the LORD. All fat is reserved for Me.

**24:12** This is a permanent law for all generations, wherever you live: you must never eat fat or blood.

**24:13** Set up a washing station west of the altar for rinsing the entrails and legs of the sacrificial animals.

**24:14** Rinse them with water and boil whatever needs boiling; then the priests shall arrange all the portions on the altar.

**24:15** Establish an ash dump on the east side of the altar, set back at a distance. The ashes shall be poured there and covered with earth.

**24:16** All these areas are holy ground. No ritually unclean person may touch them or come near the slaughtering area. Only consecrated priests may serve there in My presence.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 24 well preserved. "Layperson" used for zar to distinguish the priestly restriction from ethnic exclusion. Anatomical details in v.10 expanded slightly for modern readers unfamiliar with sacrificial butchery. "Washing station" and "ash dump" used for functional clarity.*
